The nonzero-vector permutation representation has irreducible constituents of dimensions 1, q, and q+1 (q-2 inequivalent copies), proven using scalar-central characters and a stabilizer orbit count. Schur orthogonality gives Gram eigenvalues q^2, q^3, q^4 with precisely the claimed multiplicities, all positive. Actual package checker replay verified independent full matrix spectra for q=2,3,4,5 including F_4. Numerical tests do not supply infinite proof.

value.rationale: The invertible two-by-two matrices form a natural large critical-sampling set for ambient matrix Fourier analysis. An exact N-by-N invertible Fourier minor with sharp condition q and a complete three-level singular multiplicity classification yields structural recovery and noise amplification information for every prime-power field, including characteristic two. This is neither a thin arbitrary finite example nor merely recomputation of rank-character coefficients.
